directory_policies.notes.1: Prior graduate degree: An equivalent computer science or computer engineering master's degree can make an applicant ineligible. The university determines equivalency.
directory_policies.notes.2: Reference letters: The department requires three letters for the thesis MS.

source_excerpt: The thesis MS requires three letters. GRE scores are optional and recommended. The school excludes prior equivalent master's degrees in CS or computer engineering.
